description: Two independent envelope followers that turn an amplitude-modulated audio signal back into a control voltage, each with an attenuverter, an offset, a scale and a gate output

params.text: Sets how long that channel's follower takes to rise through 10V, from 1ms fully counter-clockwise to about 0.2 seconds fully clockwise
Sets how long that channel's follower takes to fall through 10V, from 1ms fully counter-clockwise to about 0.2 seconds fully clockwise
Scales the followed envelope for that channel, -1 to 1, inverting it below 0 and silencing it at 0
Added to that channel's envelope after the attenuverter and the scale, -10V to 10V
Multiplies that channel's envelope by 1 to 3 times, after the attenuverter and before the offset

inputs.text: The amplitude-modulated audio for that channel; the channel's OUT and GATE jacks are written only while a cable is in here

outputs.text: That channel's followed envelope after the attenuverter, the scale and the offset, clamped to -15V and 15V
10V while that channel's OUT jack stands at 2V or more and 0V below that, despite the manual describing the threshold as half the follower's range

notes: A channel writes its OUT and GATE jacks only while a cable is in its IN jack. Pull that cable out and both jacks hold the last voltage they were given.
The red lamp beside an input lights when the voltage there passes 9.99V.
The green lamp beside an output follows the raw envelope, before the attenuverter, scale and offset are applied, so it can be dark while that output is high.
The module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.
